subject.title: feat(webui): redesign tool-call rendering with inline diffs, group summaries, and cheap-model purpose titles

question: Should model-generated tool-call purpose titles, including token spending and persistent caching, be a core Control UI gateway feature?
rationale: The rendering and pairing work fits the existing UI, but a decorative model call introduces a new provider-egress, billing, protocol, and persistence policy that requires explicit maintainer intent beyond code correctness.

options.title: Approve session-safe titles
options.body: Keep generated titles after effective-session provider gating, focused routing coverage, and conflict-resolved live proof.

options.title: Ship deterministic rendering only
options.body: Land the pairing, grouping, terminal, and diff improvements without the model-backed title RPC and cache.
